overview_description.description: NetworkOcean builds and operates underwater data centers, aiming to eliminate freshwater usage and significantly reduce power consumption. The company claims to cut power usage by up to 30% by utilizing efficient cooling methods through submerged installations. NetworkOcean's data centers are designed to improve internet performance with lower latency, making them suitable for tasks like GPU workloads for AI applications.
